shared_elements: circular disc motif / concentric circle vs cupmarks
incised linear/geometric marks in horizontal bands
justification: The only real overlap is generic: both surfaces carry incised schematic marks including a disc/circle motif and highly simplified human forms, things almost any carving tradition produces independently. A is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure whose whole body is the composition, with a face, arms and a chest disc arranged symmetrically on it, while B is a scattered narrative panel of repeated boats with crew strokes, quadrupeds, stick figures and cupmarks with no shared relationship or arrangement at all.
